note: Read-only audit of the six rest views against the sheet, Oct 16, 2026 (founder feedback on fur edges, chin, legs and paws). Zoomed images were scratch files; the overviews are in this folder.

defects.part: ear.R / ear.L roots under the crown (head.base, head.line)
defects.where: #1. Viewer-left ear root at crop px (52-67, 43), 3x still about (147,112); viewer-right at crop (148-163, 37), still (371,98). Right side: d01_ear_roots_R.png
defects.sheet: The ear's top tucks under the crown. Cream crown fur lies over the ear root with a soft, feathered diagonal edge. The crown's outline runs on unbroken into the ear's outer line, so there is no visible top edge on the ear.
defects.ours: Each ear ends at the top in a straight cut: horizontal on the viewer-left, diagonal on the viewer-right. It has a sharp corner on the face side and a pale airbrushed band along the cut. The tan flap pokes up past the head line, and the crown outline stops bluntly where it meets the cut. At phone size this reads as a pasted-on flap with a flat top.

defects.part: head.base cheeks over ear.R / ear.L
defects.where: #2. Viewer-left cheek edge at crop (49-52, 106-127), then a step to (54-67, 128-135); still about (128,283). Viewer-right at crop (168-173, 97-121) and (153-168, 121-131); still (427,278). Right side: d02_cheek_over_ear_R.png
defects.sheet: Each cheek is a round, convex cream puff over the ear. Its edge has small white tufts and only a short light-brown line low down, and its top joins the face patch with a rounded curve. Below the right cheek, the ear's lower lobe shows a scalloped edge.
defects.ours: The cheek is a hard-cut wedge. Its edge is nearly vertical, with a sharp notch or spike at the top where it meets the ear's inner line. The edge is a chipped, broken grey-brown line with gaps (torn-paper look) that turns at an angle into a stepped diagonal toward the collar. There is no round puff and no tufts.

defects.part: head.base chin and lower muzzle over the collar (shadow.chin.collar)
defects.where: #3. Lower corners at crop (63,133) and (157,131), still (156,322) and (375,318). Lower edge along crop x 68-150, y 133-139, centre still about (266,332)
defects.sheet: The muzzle and cheek fur is a rounded, fluffy mass. Its lower corners curve round with tufted sides. Its lower edge over the collar is a soft arc with small outlined scallops and fur points dipping onto the collar. A soft chin shadow lies on the collar's top.
defects.ours: The muzzle is a square-cornered block. The lower corners are angular steps with chipped grey-brown line bits. The lower edge is a nearly straight, blurred gradient with no line and no scallops. The collar's top edge under it is wobbly instead of being covered by fur.

defects.part: tuft (topknot) and head.line crown outline
defects.where: #4. Topknot at crop (85-150, 3-30), still about (266,36). Crown sides at crop (55-80, 25-40) and (140-165, 22-38), still (168,82) and (364,77)
defects.sheet: 4-5 small flicked locks with a crisp, thin, dark-brown line. Each lock base has a short inner overlap stroke or curl into the head. The crown's sides descend with a few clean V-shaped fur notches.
defects.ours: 3 smooth rounded lobes. The line is soft-edged and blurred, thicker and lighter, and fades out at the lock bases. Where the locks meet, the bases end in sharp dark sliver spikes. Both crown sides carry tiny stepped chips and bumps instead of clean notches, so the crown reads as smudged and smooth, not tufted.

defects.part: ear.R / ear.L outer edge and bottom lock tips
defects.where: #5. Viewer-left ear outer edge at crop (5-15, 85-115), still (30,245); bottom at crop (15-55, 130-145), still (91,341). Viewer-right outer edge at crop (205-212, 85-115), still (497,245); bottom at (165-205, 128-142), still (441,332). Right side: d05_ear_edge_R.png
defects.sheet: The outer edge is wavy, with small notches that split it into lobes. The bottom ends in 3 rounded lock tips with notches between them (scalloped). The outline varies: thin and light at the top, darker and heavier at the bottom.
defects.ours: A smooth balloon curve with no notches on the outer edge. The bottom has 1-2 shallow bumps instead of 3 lock tips. The outline is a uniform mid-brown line all the way round. The inner strand lines are fine, but the silhouette reads as a smooth droplet.

defects.part: head.patch.R / head.patch.L (eye-patch markings) edges
defects.sheet: Each tan patch is a soft rounded arc over its eye with a feathered top. On the viewer-left, a cream strip of fur at the temple separates the patch from the ear.
defects.ours: Each patch is a squared band. Its top is a bumpy, near-horizontal edge running from the ear root inward to above the eye, with a squarish inner corner. On the viewer-left, the patch runs straight into the ear root with no cream strip.

defects.part: collar band edges and ends
defects.where: #7. Band from crop (76,139) to (147,138), still (180,336)-(338,334); the ends at both of those points
defects.sheet: A curved smile-shaped band, deeper in the middle. The top edge is soft under the chin shadow, with no heavy line. The darker blue line sits mainly on the bottom edge. Both ends tuck under the lower cheek fur.
defects.ours: A flatter band with a uniform slate-blue outline all round, including a wavy, wobbly top edge. Both ends are blunt, rounded-square and fully outlined, and stand out against the chest with cream between them and the cheeks.

defects.part: body.front chest sides under the collar (against back.patch.R / back.patch.L)
defects.where: #8. Crop (67-72, 141-151) and (150-154, 139-149), still about (172,353) and (364,348). Right side: d08_chest_sides_R.png
defects.sheet: Under the collar, the body's side is a thin, smooth brown line with one small fur step, and soft tan fur texture inside it.
defects.ours: 3-4 small sharp teeth (a saw-tooth tuft) in a thick dark line right under each collar end, then a smeared, blurred tan edge further down. It reads as a chipped edge rather than fur.

defects.part: body.front chest fur strokes
defects.sheet: No dark strokes beside the tag; the chest there is plain soft cream. The chest's fur detail is a soft V of tufts below the tag (see #10).
defects.ours: Two pairs of short dark-brown dashes on each side of the tag. These are fur strokes the sheet does not draw, and they show as specks at phone size.

defects.part: between front.R and front.L (body.front belly gap, leg inner edges)
defects.sheet: Below the tag, the chest fur ends in a fluffy V of downward tufts. Thin brown lines run down both legs' inner edges from there to the paws. Between them is a narrow tan gap that closes at the ground with a short dark line.
defects.ours: There is no chest V and no tufts. A tan wedge between the legs starts as a blurred blob under the tag and widens into a hard-sided strip that runs to the ground with a peach glow. The legs' inner edges have no line at all from the chest down to the paw tops; their lines start only at the paws.

defects.part: front.R / front.L legs and front paws
defects.sheet: Short, plump columns that flare into round bun paws, wider than the legs. Each paw has a rounded bottom scalloped by the toes and 2-3 soft toe lines reaching about a third of the paw's height. The line is thin (about 1 pt), warm, and varies in weight, with gaps in places.
defects.ours: Long, straight tubes the same width as the paws. The paws have flat bottoms with squared lower corners and only two short straight toe ticks at the bottom edge. The outline is heavy and uniform: about 5 px at 3x (1.7 pt), with an L of about 105 core along the paw bottom, against the sheet's 1 px of about 0.8-1 pt.

defects.part: front.R / front.L outer edges against the haunches (back.patch.R, body.back)
defects.where: #12. Viewer-left seam at crop x 63-68, y 156-192, still about (166,427). Viewer-right line start at crop (156,165), still (373,397); line runs to crop y 212. Right side: d12_leg_edge_R.png
defects.sheet: A faint, thin, broken brown line marks each front leg's outer edge against the haunch. A small fur bump marks the elbow, where the chest fur steps out.
defects.ours: Viewer-left: a pale cream seam (a light airbrushed band) runs down between the tan haunch and the leg, and the leg's line starts abruptly partway down. Viewer-right: a heavy dark line starts in mid-air at elbow height and runs to the paw, with no line above it (only a soft gradient up to the collar). Neither side has an elbow bump.

defects.part: body.back haunch silhouette (flank-to-haunch join)
defects.sheet: Each haunch is a separate rounded lobe that bulges out of the flank from a small concave notch, a visible fur bump. The viewer-left haunch is tan with fur texture and a cream streak; the viewer-right one has a narrow tan streak at its top.
defects.ours: One smooth convex teardrop curve runs from the collar to the hind paw, with no notch, so the haunch does not read as its own shape. The viewer-left haunch is a flat tan fill with a soft gradient. The viewer-right haunch has a blurred tan airbrush patch at its top instead of a streak.

defects.part: hind.R / hind.L hind paws
defects.where: #14. Crop (45-70, 195-216) and (152-178, 195-216), still about (142,492) and (392,492). Right side: d14_hind_paws_R.png
defects.sheet: Round bun paws. Each has a closed rounded top arc where it meets the haunch, 2-3 long, soft toe lines and a rounded, gently scalloped bottom, drawn with a thin line.
defects.ours: Flat-bottomed mitten paws with a squared bottom corner and two short toe ticks. The top line is an open hook: it starts or stops in mid-air inside the paw instead of closing against the haunch and the leg. The outline is heavy and uniform.

defects.part: shadow (ground contact shadow)
defects.sheet: A wide, soft grey oval contact shadow, darkest under the paws and reaching well past both haunches.
defects.ours: A narrow, faint, warm haze close under the paws, barely visible beyond the hind paws. The dog looks less planted than on the sheet.

defects.part: far ear root / far side of head (crown end, head.base over ear.R in .L)
defects.where: L pair px x 100-160, y 70-200 (overview #1); R at x' = 531 - x
defects.sheet: The crown's brown line runs on over the far ear's root and becomes the ear's top outline. The ear's top tucks under feathered cream wisps. The face's far edge is a convex curve with a thin warm line and a soft tan shade band beside it.
defects.ours: The crown line stops in a blunt stub at the ear. The ear's top edge ends in a square corner, and the head fill cuts into the ear as a hard, unlined cream wedge, stepped twice. Below it the face meets the ear on a straight vertical seam, cream or pale tan on tan, with no line.

defects.part: far cheek fur over the far ear
defects.where: L pair px x 55-110, y 200-300 (overview #2)
defects.sheet: A rounded, two-lobed fluffy cheek puff with a clean thin warm outline on its outer edge. It sits over the ear with a soft contact shade on the ear around it, and its lower edge flows into the jaw line.
defects.ours: The cheek's outer edge is a ragged, torn-looking grey fringe of short dashes. It meets the ear with a hard concave notch at the top and leaves no contact shade on the ear. Below, the jaw line continues as a dashed, jagged grey stroke.

defects.part: near cheek over the near ear (head.base / ear.L in .L)
defects.where: L pair px x 320-340, y 235-330 (overview #3)
defects.sheet: The near ear's inner edge is one continuous warm-brown S-line from the root to the ear's bottom. The cream cheek puff below the eye is rounded and sits in front of it.
defects.ours: The ear's inner line stops at about eye level. Below that the cheek ends in a vertical, jagged, unlined cream cut against the tan ear, and its lower corner by the collar is square. The ID-pass boundary check flags this edge as unlined.

defects.part: near ear root under the crown
defects.where: L pair px x 300-360, y 95-135 (overview #4); stray tick at about (318, 50)
defects.sheet: The ear's top disappears under the crown's cream with a feathered, spiky edge of cream strands over the tan, and the crown's lock line continues down into the ear's outer outline.
defects.ours: The ear has a flat top with a soft concave bite. Its edge is blurred and unlined, and its far corner is hard, so the root reads as a cut-off shape. The crown line ends at the ear's corner, and a short loose tick hangs off the crown line just above.

defects.part: both ears: outer edges, lock tips, bottoms
defects.where: far ear L x 0-130, y 70-300; near ear L x 350-490, y 90-345 (overview #5, two circles)
defects.sheet: Droopy, rounded ears with wavy, feathered outer edges: a lock step partway down the outer side, 3-4 scalloped lock tips along each bottom with the line dipping between them, and a lighter, varied warm line.
defects.ours: The far ear is a sail: its top is one straight diagonal from the crown to the outer tip. The near ear is a smooth convex balloon. Both have even, heavy outlines with no lock step and smooth bottom arcs: the near ear's bottom shows only faint notches and the far ear's tip is a single smooth point. Fur strokes inside the ears are fine.

defects.part: crown / topknot edge
defects.where: L pair px x 130-360, y 20-110 (overview #6)
defects.sheet: A crisp brown line around each lock. A tiny wisp notch sits on the far shoulder, a thin strand line runs inside the centre lock, and the line carries on down to both ear roots.
defects.ours: The lock shapes and the line are close along the top. On the far shoulder the line turns soft and greyish with a blurred halo, inside the centre lock there is a blurred shade blob instead of the strand line, and the line stops short at both ear roots (see D1 and D4). At phone size this is mainly visible at the two ends.

defects.part: chin and lower cheeks over the collar (muzzle fur)
defects.where: L pair px x 110-345, y 280-345 (overview #7)
defects.sheet: The muzzle is a rounded, fluffy mass. Its lower edge over the collar is a warm brown line of small scallops and tufts, the near lower cheek bulges with a tuft, and the far jaw line runs unbroken into the collar.
defects.ours: A square-cornered block. Its lower edge is an airbrushed tan band with no line, so the cream fades into the collar with a fine jagged rim. The near lower corner is square against the collar end, and the far jaw line tapers out before the collar, leaving a cream notch. There are no scallops or tufts.

defects.part: collar edges and near end, neck join
defects.where: L pair px x 140-365, y 300-370 (overview #8 at the near end)
defects.sheet: The band is outlined top and bottom in dark navy. It runs on to the back's outline under the ear, with the cheek's lower edge lined above it, and the clasp is a small loop drawn with two dark lines.
defects.ours: The top edge has no outline: the chin fill sits directly on the blue with a fuzzy, jagged rim. The near end is cut square and stops short of the back line, which starts as a detached tapered stroke. Between them the cheek's lower corner is unlined against cream. The clasp is a pale pill.

defects.part: chest / back join below the collar's near end (body.front vs body.back)
defects.where: L pair px x 285-320, y 330-420 (overview #9)
defects.sheet: Soft warm shading with fine fur texture under the collar end, with no edge.
defects.ours: A peach shade band runs down from the collar's near end with a hard, straight, unlined edge where body.front's shade stops against body.back's cream. The ID-pass check flags it as an unlined part boundary.

defects.part: far front leg and the chest's lower edge between the front legs
defects.where: L pair px x 140-240, y 380-470 (overview #10)
defects.sheet: The far leg is cream (mean RGB 248,234,216). The chest's lower edge is a fluffy V of short, branching warm fur strokes meeting the near leg's line, with a soft pinkish shade between the legs.
defects.ours: The far leg is painted peach-tan (249,223,198; dE2000 about 4.7 in both views). The chest crosses it on a hard, straight, unlined diagonal, leaving a tan wedge and stripe between the legs. Three separate thin lines form a Y instead of the tufted V.

defects.part: front leg columns: far leg outer edge
defects.where: L pair px x 120-140, y 340-470 (overview #11)
defects.sheet: The far leg's outer edge is a gently convex line with small fur notches near the chest, stepping out into the bun paw. The chest fur hangs over the leg tops, so the legs read as short plump columns.
defects.ours: Wavy fur bumps on the upper third only, then a straight vertical line to the paw. Together with the peach fill (D10) the far leg reads as a separate tube from the chest's diagonal down. Measured chest-to-ground height matches the sheet in this view (the chest V is about 1 pt lower in ours), so the tube impression comes from the colour and the straight edge, not from leg length.

defects.part: front paws (near and far)
defects.where: L pair px x 120-310, y 455-518 (overview #12)
defects.sheet: Round bun paws with a softly two-lobed bottom that dips between the toes. Toe lines are short, soft and light (pale grey or pink), and the warm line is about 1.4-1.5 pt at the bottom (measured on the upscaled crop) and thins and lightens up the sides. There is no line across the top of the near paw.
defects.ours: Flat paws with a straight bottom line and tight lower corners; the far paw's line ends square at its inner corner. The outline is a constant dark line of about 1.75 pt (measured) all the way round and up both sides. Toe marks are short, dark vertical ticks, and a heavy cuff arc crosses the near paw's top, so the paw reads as a shoe.

defects.part: hind paw, thigh front and the gap between the near front paw and the hind paw
defects.where: L pair px x 280-400, y 420-515 (overview #13)
defects.sheet: The hind paw is a round bun with two soft light toe lines and a light top line fading into the thigh. Soft fur crease lines mark the thigh front, and a warm pink-tan contact shadow fills the gap between the paws at the ground.
defects.ours: A heavy, flat-bottomed paw whose top arc is a dark stroke ending in mid-fur. A pale highlight strip (a light seam) runs up the thigh front beside a long, straight, thin line. A dark spur where the paw lines meet at the ground, and there is no warm shadow in the gap.

defects.part: tail plume edge and tan root
defects.where: L pair px x 400-531, y 320-500 (overview #14)
defects.sheet: A light, broken, wavy outline with 5-6 lock bumps down the outer edge and bumps along the inner edge. The tan root breaks into feathered, spiky tufts combed down and back, with a wavy lined bottom.
defects.ours: A uniform heavier line with 2-3 shallow notches on the outer edge and a smooth inner arc. The tan root is an airbrushed blob with three thin white hairline streaks, and its bottom edge is a dark, serrated, saw-tooth stroke.

defects.part: ground contact shadow
defects.where: L pair px y 490-520, both ends of the dog (overview #15)
defects.sheet: A broad, soft grey-beige ellipse that shows clearly beyond the dog on both sides, from past the far front paw to past the tail.
defects.ours: A narrow, faint band directly under the paws that barely shows past them, so the dog sits lighter on the ground.

defects.part: crown (head top locks)
defects.where: top of head, the 4-5 curly locks from forehead to back of crown (circle 1)
defects.sheet: One crisp, continuous, warm light-brown line runs round every lock. At each join between locks the line hooks into the fur in a small V.
defects.ours: The strokes are soft and blurred, and the line is broken into separate segments with cream gaps between the locks. Each lock join is a short tapered wedge stroke with no hook, and there is a small notch where two segments meet near the front lock.

defects.part: back of head into ear top
defects.where: where the crown's back line meets the near ear's top (circle 2)
defects.sheet: The crown line runs on down the back of the head into the ear's back edge with small hooked tufts. The ear top is a blunt, flattish shape tucked under the crown fur, with a ragged feathered top edge and no line across it.
defects.ours: The crown line ends in a blurred taper that floats about 2-3 pt short of the ear. The ear top is a smooth, narrow, glossy dome with its own highlight. It sits on top of the head with no fur overlapping it, so it reads as pasted on.

defects.part: head patch at the ear root (side-view analogue of the cheek-over-ear wedge)
defects.where: tan area between the brow and the ear's front edge (circle 3)
defects.sheet: The patch's top edge against the cream crown breaks into small feathered fur tufts. It darkens toward the ear, and the ear's front edge is a wavy line with a small lock S-curve.
defects.ours: A smooth, rounded, pale peach lobe rises beside the ear top. Its edge is blurred and has no line or tufts. The ear's front edge is one smooth curve.

defects.part: near ear, outer edge and fur
defects.where: the ear's back and front edges, mid-height (circle 4)
defects.sheet: The edge is wavy and asymmetric. A back lock bulges out with a notch at about mid-height, with a lighter inner lock line along the back edge. The line is thin and varies in weight, and there are only a few soft, irregular fur strokes.
defects.ours: The ear is a symmetric smooth egg (balloon) with an even, heavy line all round. Five or six evenly spaced parallel fur strokes look like a comb, and one separate inner stroke runs near the back top.

defects.part: near ear, hem and lock tips
defects.where: bottom of the ear over the collar and the back (circle 5)
defects.sheet: The hem is round and U-shaped, made of about four distinct rounded lock tips with clear notches. The rearmost lock curls up the back edge.
defects.ours: The hem is wide and nearly flat, with three shallow notches. Its lowest point comes to a small V-shaped point, and the back corner has a hard kink.

defects.part: chin, jaw and lower cheek over the collar
defects.where: under the mouth down to the collar's front end and along the collar top (circle 6)
defects.sheet: A crisp, dark warm-brown chin line runs all the way to the collar's front and ends in a small tufted wiggle. The muzzle fur's lower edge hangs over the collar's top in white wispy strands with a small scalloped fringe and a little soft peach shade above it.
defects.ours: The chin line is lighter (rgb 180,137,107 against the sheet's 144,101,76) and fades out about 2 pt before reaching the collar. The jaw's lower edge is simply the collar's clean top edge, with a blurred, unlined peach shade band above it and no strands or scallops. In side.R a broad blurred tan shade runs diagonally across the whole lower cheek.

defects.part: tag and collar front end
defects.where: collar's front end and the hanging tag (circle 7)
defects.sheet: The tag is a rounded gold heart or coin with an embossed heart and a thin darker rim, hung from a small ring. The collar's front end has a darker blue loop band where the ring attaches.
defects.ours: The tag is an apple or peach shape with a stem nub on top, an apple-shaped inner ring and a heavy dark-gold outline. The collar's front is a plain rounded tube end with no loop band.

defects.part: forehead profile and nose join
defects.where: head outline from the front crown lock down the forehead to the nose (circle 8)
defects.sheet: One smooth S-curve runs from the first crown lock down through the stop and the bridge into a rounded, drop-shaped nose.
defects.ours: At the top, a stray spike stroke from the front crown lock crosses the forehead line. Partway down the forehead the line has a step kink where two segments meet. Where the bridge line meets the nose top there is a jagged black crumb, and the nose is a tilted ellipse.

defects.part: front paws (near and far): outline and toe lines
defects.where: both front paws on the ground (circle 9)
defects.sheet: Round bun paws closed all the way round by an even medium-brown line about 1.5 pt wide. Two or three faint, thin, curved toe lines follow the bun's front.
defects.ours: A heavy dark sole stroke thickens under each paw and tapers to nothing at the heel, so the back of the paw is open. The toe marks are dark, pointed ticks standing straight up from the sole, which read as claws.

defects.part: near front leg top
defects.where: across the near front leg just above the paw (circle 10)
defects.sheet: There is no line here: the leg melts into the paw.
defects.ours: A curved hook stroke about 13 pt long runs from the paw's top front across the leg and ends in a taper mid-leg.

defects.part: near front leg back edge, paw heel and the belly between the paws
defects.where: between the near front paw and the hind paw at the ground (circle 11)
defects.sheet: A dark V-shaped crease with warm peach shade closes the front paw's heel against the hind paw. The thigh's front line runs down into that crease, and the ground line is continuous under both paws.
defects.ours: An open, unlined light column runs between the paws: the near paw's back has no line, a soft vertical peach band stands in for the leg's back, and the ground shadow shows through the gap. The thigh's front line stops short, before it reaches the hind paw.

defects.part: hind paw and haunch sole
defects.where: ground edge under the hind paw's heel and the haunch: canvas x 514-578 in side.L and x 322-386 in side.R, 6 px/pt (circle 12)
defects.sheet: A continuous dark sole line runs along the whole ground edge under the hind paw and haunch, measured at about 1.5-1.7 pt wide and L* about 107.
defects.ours: About 10.7 pt of the ground edge has no line at all: the profile scans find no dip. The paw's line and the haunch's line each stop on either side of the gap.

defects.part: hind paw top and toes
defects.where: top of the hind paw where it meets the thigh (circle 13)
defects.sheet: The paw's top is a soft line that merges into the thigh. There are two faint, thin, curved toe lines.
defects.ours: The paw's top arc overshoots past the paw as a hook into the haunch and ends in a taper. The toe marks are three dark claw-like ticks standing up from the sole.

defects.part: body side and haunch front
defects.where: from under the collar down to the hind paw's top (circle 14)
defects.sheet: The near side reads as one soft cream mass. The haunch's front is a single curved line rising from the hind paw and fading out upward, with no vertical banding.
defects.ours: A straight vertical light-and-dark seam runs from under the collar down to the hind paw and splits the body into two flat columns. A second vertical peach shade band runs down the back of the near front leg.

defects.part: tail plume edge
defects.where: outer edge and tip of the tail plume (circle 15)
defects.sheet: An irregular, flame-like edge of pointed locks with wispy strands flicking outward. The line is thin, light and broken, and the tip curls over as one continuous hooked lock.
defects.ours: A uniform mid-brown line with regular, evenly sized round bumps, like a cog or a cloud. At the tip, a detached inner curl stroke leaves a gap in the outline.

defects.part: tail root marking and the tail foot
defects.where: tan root of the tail beside the rump and where the tail's bottom meets the haunch (circle 16)
defects.sheet: The tan is painted as streaky brown brush strands radiating from the rump, darkest at the root. The tail's underside rolls into the haunch in a rounded lock.
defects.ours: A blurred tan blob with two or three thin white streaks across it that look like scratches. Where the tail's bottom line meets the haunch outline, it forms a sharp acute corner.

defects.part: haunch back outline over the tail
defects.where: rump outline between the haunch and the tail plume, side.R canvas x about 190, y 680-935 (circle 17)
defects.sheet: A medium-dark warm-brown line (mirrored crop) separates the haunch from the tail cleanly.
defects.ours: The line turns pale grey-beige, apparently from the line-by-light rule on the lit back side, so it reads as a faint seam instead of the haunch's outline. side.L draws the same edge dark brown.

defects.part: saddle (back patch) edge
defects.where: patch on the upper back behind the ear (circle 18)
defects.sheet: The patch has streaky, feathered brush edges with darker strands following the back's curve.
defects.ours: A flat, even blob with a blurred, regularly scalloped lower edge. Its top-left edge is harder than any other edge of the patch.

defects.part: ground shadow
defects.where: ground under and in front of the paws (circle 19)
defects.sheet: A clearly visible lilac-grey ellipse reaches well in front of the front paws and back under the tail.
defects.ours: A faint, narrow, warm-grey smudge that is barely visible at phone size.

groups.name: G1 Line spans: one continuous line per visible edge, short taper only at free ends
groups.cause: parts/lines.ts tapers every span at both ends (default min(5, len/3), lines.ts:89-97; DECISIONS 74 'each span tapers to nothing at both ends'), and the views pass long tapers (front.ts:706 taper [6,16] on the leg/paw span, :382-383 taper 4). The views also give each lock or segment its own span (front.ts:401, threeQuarter.ts:331 and :571-573, side.ts:593, back.ts:43-44, :325, :489). So every handoff leaves 5-17 pt below full width, and spans that start under a part fade out over visible edge. Overlap (part-over-part) edges have no depth floor, so in .R facings the line-by-light rule paints them pale. Verified in source: lines.ts:89-97, front.ts:375-395 and :700-706.
groups.recipeChange:
In LitSpan:
- One span per visible edge. A fur edge is one span that follows furEdge's notches.
- Taper only free ends, over 1.5-2 pt.
- An end that meets another line joins it at full width on a shared point.
- An end that runs under another part carries on at least 1 pt under it at full width.
- A new `contact: true` flag (part over part) floors depth at about 0.5, so overlap lines stay dark in both facings.
- Paw top arcs and heels close on the neighbouring line, with no overshoot hooks.

Lint (draw/lint.ts) fails any visible-edge gap over 2 pt and any taper over 2 pt, unless the span cites a DECISIONS entry. New DECISIONS replace 74's taper clause, 7's 'no line between' cheek and ear, 33/72's handoff of the chin edge to the collar rim, and 64's unlined near-leg back, each citing its crop.

groups.name: G2 Crisp outer line: no blur on the silhouette side

groups.cause:

- **Paw shapes:** every view types flat soles (within 1.4 pt of flat), toe dips of 0.1-0.7 pt (none in side) and outer corners of about r 4 pt, on straight columns (front.ts:94-120, threeQuarter.ts:57-76, side.ts:82-101, back.ts:174-179).
- **Sole line:** the ground term makes the whole sole the darkest tone at 1.6 pt with only a ±6% wobble (lines.ts:37, :49, :53, :96). finish.test.ts:70-80 pins at least 1.55 pt and tones 8 and up (DECISIONS 74, 79).
- **Leg lines:** the front's single span (inner side, paw, outer side) has taper [6,16] (front.ts:706), so leg lines start in mid-air and the outer line runs up near the collar, which makes the tube look.
- **Missing and stray marks:** no view draws an elbow or haunch bump; paw top arcs overshoot as hooks or cuffs; DECISIONS 64 leaves the near leg's back and heel unlined.
- **Existing decisions not met:** DECISIONS 47 (bun paws wider than the leg) and 82 (outline closed all round) already ask for this, so this is an implementation gap.

- **Toe lines:** 2-3, rising 40-50% of the paw's height, following the dome, in the warm line at about 50% opacity, fading gently, never darker than the outline.
- **Outline:** closed round every visible edge. The top arc stops at the leg's line, and hind paws close against the haunch.

**Line (lines.ts).** The ground term applies only to the middle ~60% of the sole, where the paw presses: 1.3-1.5 pt there, thinning to about 1.2 pt and lightening up the sides, with ±15% wobble.

- **Back:** haunch bottoms rounded (corner r about 10 pt; at crop y 212 the silhouette spans x 61-139) with small fur bumps, the bottom line no darker than the sides.

- Back: the patch sits inside the lined edge.
